utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twentieth. Can you hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Better than my weekend, anyway. Had plans for a barbecue and the weather absolutely did us.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's because you announced it. Never tell the British weather your intentions.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Next weekend's plans are indoors. Not falling for that little sunshine symbol again.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Talking of shiny things, whose new car is that in the car park? Very brave parking it under those trees.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with more biscuit crumbs than upholstery.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ah, factory specification. Mine's got that package as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, before we get onto finance options. Finished bits first?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I already swapped the filter on the Stretch Wrapper yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Oh, right. I was looking at the old entry, then.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: You were, yeah. Nothing left on that filter change.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the turbine one on Tuesday. Last Tuesday, obviously. That's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Lovely. Both historical, not more work for this morning.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: heard a slight rattle from the line 2 interlock. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just a little chatter, was it? Not calling for a job on it?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. A slight rattle, that's all I'm reporting. No action off the back of that yet.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Separately, Sarah, can you check the guarding on the line 2 robot at half two?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll check the guarding on the line 2 robot at half two.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Normal priority on that. It's not an escalation from the rattle observation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Normal priority, half two.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Before I forget, that charity bake sale on Friday was brilliant. Last Friday, I mean. Whoever did the lemon cake—

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: —accounted for most of your lunch? Yeah, we noticed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Back to machinery, cake-powered or otherwise. Callum, can you book a contractor to look at the wrapper? Monday for the booking, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll book a contractor to look at the wrapper Monday, so today. Low priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the booking today, not expecting a contractor through the gate today?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Correct. Monday is for making the booking. We're not agreeing an arrival time here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine, I've got the booking. And that's separate from the finished filter change.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: While we're on suppliers, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Main Water Isolation Valve. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: So that hasn't actually moved since the last update?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No. No confirmed delivery. Just reporting the same blocker, not putting another job on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, that stays as a blocker.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Saz, can you chase the purchase order for the forklifts today at 2pm? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, I'll chase the purchase order for the forklifts today at 2pm. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: You've got the afternoon in nice little slices, haven't you?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Apparently. Purchase order at two, guarding at half two. Different things, both clear.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Aisha, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve today at 2pm?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that sign-off. I'm not available at two, so don't put that against me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, Callum, can you take that instead of Aisha: do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve today at 2pm?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I can take it. I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the relief valve seals—those are a separate item from that sign-off, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, separate items. Don't merge them just because both have valve in the name.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll replace the seals on the relief valve today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thanks, Olu. The relief valve seals are yours today, then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do those today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Got you. That's the distinction I was after; the short names can sound the same over this audio.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cal, can you order spare parts for the palletizer as well? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll order spare parts for the palletizer. Fairly important, got it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped slightly. Was that the important one, rather than the contractor booking?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yes. Spare parts for the palletizer: fairly important. Contractor booking: low priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's how I've got them. Parts order is mine as well.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: One blocker before we finish: I can't get to the Fire Alarm Panel until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There isn't an agreed window at the moment. I can't give you a time on this call.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, so that stays parked. Not saying I'm doing the Fire Alarm Panel today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. Blocked, not another allocation.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Is anyone else getting every third word through a tin can, or is that just my headset?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Bit of both, I reckon. Teams has decided we're all underwater.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: There's quite a lot of background noise at my end. Probably not helping.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: The actual decisions came through, anyway. It was mostly the cake discussion that broke up.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Probably for the best. Everyone clear on what they've accepted, and what's just blocked or finished?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, all clear here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same here. No mystery jobs hiding in the cake chat.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. That's us, then. Cheers, everyone.
